name: Ollama
description: Runs and serves large language models locally via a CLI, API, and Docker image; footprint scales with the loaded model.

no_official_figure.note: Ollama publishes no base/runtime RAM or CPU figure for the app itself — actual memory use is set entirely by which model is loaded (per-model sizes are listed on individual ollama.com/library model pages, not as a single app-level spec). Open upstream issue #2418 ('What are the system requirements?') requests this documentation for disk/RAM/GPU. Per-model tiers are out of scope for this entry — encoding one model's footprint as the app's min/rec figure would misrepresent scope (Open WebUI precedent, Defect Class #2/#3).
